gaps.quote: and the rank is the absolute change $|\Delta|$
gaps.note: The rank is defined as the dimension of an orthogonal complement inside the larger label. The page does not show that this dimension equals the difference of the two label dimensions.

gaps.term: sink dimensions sum to Wm minus mu
gaps.quote: The sink dimensions sum to $Wm-\mu$, so $\sum\Delta=Wm-2\mu$.
gaps.note: This needs each sink dimension to be m minus the matching source dimension, which the page never states or justifies.

gaps.quote: The signed sum over all edges is therefore the sum of sink dimensions minus the sum of source dimensions.
gaps.note: The argument is phrased per gate incidence. The page does not show that each wire's edges form a chain from its source to its sink, so that the signed sums telescope wire by wire.
The identity holds only if loss equals minus the signed change, which is not stated. Per-edge loss is also undefined.
